{{Quote|Lieutenant, did the kidnappers see you?''"<br />"''No, sir. We're the best scouts in the regiment.|Anakin Skywalker, and an ARF trooper|<ref name="TCW film" />}}
A '''regiment''' of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] participated early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. The [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] was made up of at least two [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF troopers]], a [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Force commander/Legends|commander]] and a [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Force lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], being considered the regiment's best [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. The two were dispatched with a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] to track down a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].<ref name="TCW film" />

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The regiment first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the animated theatrical film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']]<ref name="TCW film" /> which was released on [[August 15]], [[2008]] in the United States<ref name="Announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news/announcement.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' In Theaters and on Television in 2008}}</ref> and was directed by [[Dave Filoni]].<ref name="TCW film" />
